Excluded as schools per the brief's excluded types: Crossroads Early Learning Center (licensed child care/preschool), Unitarian Montessori School, Busy Little Hands Christian Montessori. All three are private businesses that market to parents and could be reconsidered if the team wants child care operators.
The Barker Lounge is excluded as a franchise (The Barker Lounge Franchising LLC, nine locations in five states) whose site and booking portal are controlled centrally.
Aldersgate Thrift Store is a church-run nonprofit thrift shop. It is retail, not worship, so it was triaged, but its budget is effectively nil.

Phone numbers in batch.json do not always match the business's own site: Kaye-Lynn (2071 in batch vs 2074 in the site header and on Google) and Aldersgate (732-254-7361 in batch vs 732-307-7430 on Google).
Agent-readiness 'findable' scores are conservative: I could confirm a claimed-looking GBP with hours/category/website, but could not inspect the profile owner view or services/photos completeness.
data_gaps: Google review counts for all businesses (limited Maps view hides them).
Crossroads Early Learning Center's site could not be loaded - navigation timed out and script evaluation timed out twice; page contents were therefore taken from search snippets only.
No pricing/tuition information found for Donna Bridals, Kaye-Lynn Dance Studio, Allegiance landscaping projects or Pascarella delivery - these may exist only in phone conversations.
Allegiance reviews embed a Google widget but no aggregate rating or count is printed on the page.
Royal Fur has only a single public review visible on aggregators (Yahoo), so the 5.0 Google rating is based on a very small sample.
I did not submit any form, so form delivery/response behaviour (e.g. whether Donna Bridals' quote form actually sends) is unverified.
